verdict.rationale: Portkey docs explicitly support issuing API keys with budget and rate limits (spend thresholds, hourly/daily/per-minute request/token limits) that automatically block further usage when exceeded, directly matching the guardrail need for an autonomous agent's key. Fine-grained control at org/workspace level and per-key configuration is documented. Missing for 10: no explicit mention of a per-agent key issuance workflow or independent/hands-on verification that the cutoff actually stops an agent mid-run.
